mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM flow_instance WHERE del_flag = '0' AND flow_status = '1') AS runningInstances, (SELECT count(*) FROM flow_task WHERE del_flag = '0' AND node_type = 1) AS myTodos, (SELECT count(*) FROM flow_instance WHERE del_flag = '0' AND flow_status IN ('2','8') AND update_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 7 day)) AS done7d, (SELECT count(*) FROM flow_definition WHERE del_flag = '0') AS definitions, (SELECT count(*) FROM flow_definition WHERE del_flag = '0' AND is_publish = 1) AS published, (SELECT count(*) FROM flow_task WHERE del_flag = '0' AND node_type = 1 AND create_time < date_sub(now(), interval 8 hour)) AS urgentTodos

SELECT date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') AS d, count(*) AS a, sum(case when flow_status IN ('2','8') then 1 else 0 end) AS b FROM flow_instance WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) GROUP BY date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') ORDER BY d

SELECT concat('def_', d.id) AS id, d.flow_code AS code, d.flow_name AS name, d.category AS cat, d.version, case when d.is_publish = 1 then 'published' else 'draft' end AS status, case when d.form_custom = 'Y' then '自定义表单' else '动态表单' end AS form, coalesce(d.form_path, '') AS formPath, d.ext, date_format(d.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updated, (SELECT count(*) FROM flow_node n WHERE n.definition_id = d.id AND n.del_flag = '0') AS nodeCount, (SELECT count(*) FROM flow_skip s WHERE s.definition_id = d.id AND s.del_flag = '0') AS skipCount, (SELECT count(*) FROM flow_instance i WHERE i.definition_id = d.id AND i.del_flag = '0') AS inst, (SELECT count(*) FROM flow_instance i WHERE i.definition_id = d.id AND i.del_flag = '0' AND i.flow_status = '1') AS running FROM flow_definition d
d.del_flag = '0'
AND (d.flow_name LIKE concat('%', #{p.keyword}, '%') OR d.flow_code LIKE concat('%', #{p.keyword}, '%'))
AND d.category = #{p.cat} AND d.is_publish = #{p.publishFlag}
ORDER BY d.update_time DESC

SELECT concat('def_', d.id) AS id, d.flow_code AS code, d.flow_name AS name, d.category AS cat, d.version, d.ext, case when d.is_publish = 1 then 'published' else 'draft' end AS status, case when d.form_custom = 'Y' then '自定义表单' else '动态表单' end AS form, coalesce(d.form_path, '') AS formPath, date_format(d.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updated FROM flow_definition d WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.del_flag = '0'

SELECT n.node_code AS id, n.node_name AS name, case n.node_type when 0 then 'start' when 1 then 'task' when 2 then 'end' when 3 then 'gateway' when 4 then 'parallel' else 'task' end AS type, n.coordinate, n.handler_path AS assignee, n.permission_flag AS policy, n.form_path AS formPath, n.ext FROM flow_node n WHERE n.definition_id = #{defId} AND n.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY n.create_time ASC

SELECT s.now_node_code AS `from`, s.next_node_code AS `to`, s.skip_condition AS cond, s.skip_name AS label, 1 AS priority FROM flow_skip s WHERE s.definition_id = #{defId} AND s.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY s.create_time ASC

SELECT concat('FI-', i.id) AS id, concat('def_', i.definition_id) AS defId, coalesce(i.business_id, concat('BIZ-', i.id)) AS biz, coalesce(i.business_id, i.node_name, concat('流程实例 ', i.id)) AS title, i.create_by AS starter, date_format(i.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS start, i.node_code AS curNode, i.node_name AS cur, AS status, date_format(i.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS end, d.flow_name AS defName, d.flow_code AS defCode, d.version AS defVersion FROM flow_instance i LEFT JOIN flow_definition d ON i.definition_id = d.id
i.del_flag = '0'
AND i.flow_status IN ('0','1','9','11') AND i.flow_status IN ('2','8') AND i.flow_status IN ('4','5','6','10')
AND (i.business_id LIKE concat('%', #{p.keyword}, '%') OR i.create_by LIKE concat('%', #{p.keyword}, '%') OR i.node_name LIKE concat('%', #{p.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY i.create_time DESC

SELECT concat('FI-', i.id) AS id, concat('def_', i.definition_id) AS defId, coalesce(i.business_id, concat('BIZ-', i.id)) AS biz, coalesce(i.business_id, i.node_name, concat('流程实例 ', i.id)) AS title, i.create_by AS starter, i.variable, date_format(i.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS start, i.node_code AS curNode, i.node_name AS cur, AS status, date_format(i.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS end, d.flow_name AS defName, d.flow_code AS defCode, d.version AS defVersion FROM flow_instance i LEFT JOIN flow_definition d ON i.definition_id = d.id WHERE i.id = #{id} AND i.del_flag = '0'

SELECT concat('TK-', t.id) AS id, concat('FI-', t.instance_id) AS instId, concat('def_', t.definition_id) AS defId, concat('TK-', t.id) AS taskNo, t.node_name AS node, coalesce(i.business_id, t.node_name) AS title, coalesce(u.actual_name, i.create_by) AS starter, date_format(t.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS arrived, t.instance_id AS instanceId, t.definition_id AS definitionId, i.variable, d.flow_name AS defName, d.version AS defVersion FROM flow_task t LEFT JOIN flow_instance i ON t.instance_id = i.id LEFT JOIN flow_definition d ON t.definition_id = d.id LEFT JOIN flow_user fu ON fu.associated = t.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.employee_id = cast(i.create_by as unsigned)
t.del_flag = '0' AND t.node_type = 1 AND t.flow_status = '1' AND fu.processed_by = #{p.userId}
AND (t.node_name LIKE concat('%', #{p.keyword}, '%') OR i.business_id LIKE concat('%', #{p.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC

SELECT concat('CC-', i.id) AS id, coalesce(i.business_id, i.node_name) AS title, i.create_by AS `from`, i.node_name AS node, date_format(i.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS time, concat('FI-', i.id) AS instId, concat('def_', i.definition_id) AS defId FROM flow_user a LEFT JOIN flow_instance i ON a.associated = i.id LEFT JOIN flow_definition d ON i.definition_id = d.id WHERE a.type = 4 AND a.del_flag = '0' AND i.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY i.update_time DESC

SELECT concat('FI-', i.id) AS id, concat('def_', i.definition_id) AS defId, coalesce(i.business_id, i.node_name) AS title, i.node_name AS cur, i.node_code AS curNode, i.create_by AS starter, date_format(i.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS start, AS status, d.flow_name AS defName FROM flow_instance i LEFT JOIN flow_definition d ON i.definition_id = d.id WHERE i.del_flag = '0' AND i.create_by = #{userId} ORDER BY i.create_time DESC

SELECT s.next_node_code AS nodeCode, n.node_name AS nodeName FROM flow_task t LEFT JOIN flow_skip s ON s.definition_id = t.definition_id AND s.now_node_code = t.node_code AND s.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN flow_node n ON n.definition_id = t.definition_id AND n.node_code = s.next_node_code AND n.del_flag = '0' WHERE t.id = #{taskId} AND t.del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_definition (id, flow_code, flow_name, category, version, is_publish, form_custom, form_path, activity_status, ext, create_time, update_time, del_flag) VALUES (#{id}, #{flowCode}, #{flowName}, #{category}, #{version}, #{isPublish}, #{formCustom}, #{formPath}, 1, #{ext}, now(), now(), '0')
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_definition SET flow_name = #{flowName}, version = #{version}, is_publish = #{isPublish}, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'
UPDATE flow_node SET del_flag = '1', update_time = now() WHERE definition_id = #{defId} AND del_flag = '0'
UPDATE flow_skip SET del_flag = '1', update_time = now() WHERE definition_id = #{defId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_node (id, definition_id, node_type, node_code, node_name, coordinate, handler_type, handler_path, permission_flag, form_path, ext, create_time, update_time, del_flag) VALUES (#{id}, #{definitionId}, #{nodeType}, #{nodeCode}, #{nodeName}, #{coordinate}, #{handlerType}, #{handlerPath}, #{permissionFlag}, #{formPath}, #{ext}, now(), now(), '0')

INSERT INTO flow_skip (id, definition_id, now_node_code, next_node_code, skip_name, skip_type, skip_condition, coordinate, create_time, update_time, del_flag) VALUES (#{id}, #{definitionId}, #{from}, #{to}, #{label}, #{skipType}, #{cond}, '', now(), now(), '0')
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS taskId, t.instance_id AS instanceId, t.definition_id AS definitionId, t.node_code AS nodeCode, t.node_name AS nodeName, t.flow_status AS taskStatus, i.flow_status AS instanceStatus FROM flow_task t LEFT JOIN flow_instance i ON t.instance_id = i.id WHERE t.id = #{taskId} AND t.del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_task SET flow_status = #{status}, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_his_task (id, definition_id, instance_id, task_id, node_code, node_name, target_node_code, approver, cooperate_type, skip_type, flow_status, message, create_time, update_time, del_flag) VALUES (#{id}, #{definitionId}, #{instanceId}, #{taskId}, #{nodeCode}, #{nodeName}, #{targetNodeCode}, #{approver}, #{cooperateType}, #{skipType}, #{flowStatus}, #{message}, now(), now(), '0')
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_instance SET node_code = #{nodeCode}, node_name = #{nodeName}, flow_status = #{status}, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{instanceId} AND del_flag = '0'
